notes: Inbound SMB lead from content ops platform. Primary pain: cost on high-volume copy generation + desire to speed up multi-variant landing page loops. Typical workflow: CMS push -> templated prompts -> bulk generate 50-200 variants -> dedupe via embeddings -> rerank and pick top 5. Wants to run this in hosted API (self-serve) — prefers public cloud for simplicity. Key asks: concrete batching/caching examples, recommended models (cost vs quality), limits on concurrent requests, streaming webhooks for fast user preview. Latency/throughput: interactive authoring tolerates 300-800ms median for short completions, but batch jobs must be able to sustain 100-200 concurrent small requests during nightly runs. Cost target: ideally <= $0.0015 per 1k tokens average (they benchmarked current vendor at ~$0.0022). Security: SOC2 required for vendor, audit logs preferred, SSO not needed at SMB stage but may be later. Quote from buyer: "We need a predictable per-variant cost number before committing to a POC." AE notes: prefer short POC (2 weeks) focused on batching + caching to prove 30% savings.
